name: PokeDaisy

original.title: Pokemon Game Boy, Game Boy Color, GBA and DS games and ROM hacks

update.channel: manual APK from pokedaisy.com (latest listed there: 1.6.2.2)

assets.needs: Your own Pokemon ROMs (.gb/.gbc/.gba/.nds) and ROM hacks.
assets.location: Scans the folders in prefs key roms_folders (one entry per ROM folder, e.g. /storage/<sd-card>/Roms/GBA). Cocoon also lists it as a player, so it can be launched with a ROM file.
assets.notes: files/rom-titles.tsv lists the games it recognises; other ROMs in the scanned folders are marked unsupported (U) in rom-folder-scan.tsv.

settings.in_app_menu: Library > Settings (tabs), plus a quick menu in game.
settings.summary: Picture aspect (Original/Stretch/Expand; Expand is stored as WIDE), smoothing (xBRZ/xBR/ScaleFX), screen filter (LCD/scanlines/CRT), DS layout, DS resolution 1-8x, DS core (Auto/melonDS/DSperate), fast-forward and rewind, swap screens, single-screen mode, and many Pokemon-specific helpers (instant text, EXP share, level cap, HM-free, reusable TMs, shiny odds, day/night, follower).

controls: Built-in controller support with hotkeys (hotkeys_enabled), on-screen touch controls with skins, layouts and opacity.
display: Made for dual-screen handhelds: game on the top screen and a live companion (party, battle info, boxes) on the bottom screen; DS games can use both screens in several layouts; single_screen and swap_screens options.
saves: /sdcard/Android/data/com.pokedaisy.app/files/saves/ by default, or the folder in saves_dir_override; extra_save_dirs adds more. Save backups (save_backups_keep, default 10).
notes: The prefs file counts launches (app_open_count). It can hold secrets once you sign in (ra_token, ra_web_api_key, ss_password, steamgriddb_api_key): never print them. Firebase Crashlytics is bundled (crash_reports_enabled, off by default).
